summary: Executed backend API regression and browser smoke coverage for authentication, dashboard, theme, inventory, asset mutation, maintenance, reports, and activity flows. Backend core mutations passed, but activity retrieval fails with HTTP 500 and the activity page shows an uncaught runtime error.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 because nested Mongo ObjectId values inside activity snapshots are not recursively removed/serialized. Traceback: FastAPI jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId.

ui_bugs.issue: Activity API rejection is not caught; navigating to Activity Logs produces an uncaught runtime error overlay and no logs.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend cannot load or filter persisted events while /api/activity returns 500.

AuthCallback is defined but never mounted as a route. Hash callback handling in AuthGate skips auth/me and then redirects unauthenticated users to /login, so the external Google flow cannot reliably complete.

action_items: Recursively sanitize ObjectId values in activity documents or ensure all nested snapshots are JSON-safe before returning /api/activity.
Add an error state to ActivityPage instead of allowing an unhandled promise rejection/runtime overlay.
Mount and verify the OAuth callback route or update AuthGate callback handling so session_id is exchanged and dashboard navigation completes.
critical_code_review_comments: Activity endpoint uses clean() that only removes top-level _id; Mongo ObjectId can remain in nested before/after snapshots.
React Hook lint warnings remain for Inventory and AssetDetail load dependencies.
Settings and notifications controls are present but have no behavior; global search button is present but not interactive despite the all-buttons-working requirement.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_API inspection maintenance request, checked out/checked in a seeded asset as TEST_API Holder, and registered Browser Test Asset via UI; these remain in the configured demo database.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo credentials were read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Login, dashboard, dark theme, inventory search, asset registration, checkout/checkin, maintenance creation/status advancement, reports, and unauthenticated protection were exercised. Activity endpoint is currently blocked by nested ObjectId serialization.
rca of the issue: GET /api/activity projects only the document _id and calls clean(), which removes only the top-level _id. Existing or newly stored activity before/after snapshots can contain nested Mongo ObjectId values. FastAPI response encoding then raises ValueError, yielding HTTP 500. The ActivityPage calls api('/activity') without a catch handler, so the rejected promise becomes a visible React runtime error overlay.
